newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers quiet with low demand.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers quiet with low demand.

text.p: The Singapore bunker market held steady in quiet trade on Wednesday and many traders were on the sidelines searching for new market direction.
"Demand is quite poor," said one trader. "Prices in Singapore are on the high side now but some sellers are even waiting for higher prices."
"Buyers may just turn to other cheaper ports," he added.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $102-$104 per tonne and 180-cst was at $109-$111. MDO and gas oil were quoted at $188-$192 and $202-204 respectively.
